name: Spring Boot Application Descriptor
description: Structure of a Spring Boot project descriptor as used by Spring Initializr

fields.name: type
fields.description: Build system: maven-project, gradle-project, or gradle-project-kotlin

fields.name: language
fields.description: Programming language: java, kotlin, or groovy

fields.name: groupId
fields.description: Maven group ID for the project (e.g., com.example)

fields.name: artifactId
fields.description: Maven artifact ID / project name (e.g., my-application)

fields.name: description
fields.description: Brief description of the project purpose

fields.name: packaging
fields.description: Archive packaging type: jar or war

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: List of Spring Boot starter dependency IDs to include

items.description: Starter dependency ID (e.g., web, data-jpa, security, actuator)
